    Kalyan Residency is an elegant 3 star hotel with 58 well appointed rooms designed for a comfortable stay in Tirupati. The hotel is centrally air-conditioned and has a tranquil ambiance. You can witness a panoramic view of the Tirumala Hills.

    The friendly staff and a professional service means your stay in Tirupati is hassle-free and relaxing. You can always rely on us for guidance for visiting the famous tourist places in and around Tirupati.

    The in-house restaurant menu has the choicest of cuisines from South India, having more than 225 platters of Indian, Continental and Chinese food on offer.

    We have the best equipped banquet halls in Tirupati, where you can host anything from a wedding reception to birthday parties or formal conferences of up to 250 persons.
